title: Minimum Defensible Verification — Real Repository Shadow Calibration
question: On the pinned real public repository and frozen corpus, can Affected Verification reduce proposed verification workload while selecting every check that the frozen full-verification oracle demonstrates was relevant?

arms.definition: Execute every frozen catalog check. This arm is authoritative.
Use Vitest 4.1.10 related selection for frozen changed paths. It predicts test checks only.
Use Git change identity, deterministic static source graph, frozen catalog, and frozen policy without native selection output.
Use AV_CORE evidence plus normalized native-selected tests as one additional evidence source; native evidence never replaces policy or the full oracle.

baseline.requirement: Every frozen check must pass in every clean repetition with stable test-file and test-execution counts.
baseline.stop: Stop before comparative scenarios if the baseline materially fails, flakes, drifts, or cannot complete within the practical host bound.

relevance_oracle.scope: Relevant within this frozen verification catalog.
procedure: Confirm the check passes on every qualifying clean baseline repetition.
Materialize the exact scenario patch and validate its identity.
Execute the complete frozen catalog regardless of predicted plans.
A check is relevant when its normalized outcome changes from clean PASS to scenario FAIL.
Preserve raw command output and normalized identity-bound outcomes.
relevance_oracle.limit: The oracle identifies known catalog checks that expose a scenario effect; it does not prove complete software correctness or production-bug representativeness.

primary_metric.definition: A frozen relevant check failed under FULL and was omitted by the selector arm.
primary_metric.rule: Report every miss individually. Any Affected Verification miss prevents movement beyond SHADOW and requires root-cause analysis.

workload: test executions available, selected, and skipped
test files available, selected, and skipped
non-test checks selected and skipped by type
metrics.runtime: Wall-clock durations are OBSERVED only, excluded from semantic identities, and do not by subtraction establish causal time saved.
metrics.native_comparison: Report where either selector is narrower, where AV broadens native output, and where either misses a relevant check.

analysis_rules: Correctness and misses are reported before workload.
No missing observation is interpreted as zero.
Unlike workload units are not combined.
Synthetic faults test selection correctness but do not estimate production-bug frequency.
Zero observed misses means only that no miss was observed in this frozen corpus.
No post-outcome policy, catalog, scenario, oracle, or metric change is permitted in revision 1.
A genuine harness defect requires a preserved revision-1 record and a versioned amended preregistration.
stop_conditions: target, lockfile, tool, catalog, scenario, or patch identity drift
materially failing or flaky clean baseline
incomplete FULL execution for an analyzed scenario
a harness defect that can affect selection, relevance, or result identity
inability to preserve raw full-run evidence
attempt to let an affected arm replace or bypass FULL
trust_decision_rule: Remain OBSERVE/SHADOW. This first calibration cannot authorize TRUSTED_BOUNDED even with zero observed misses.
providers: No model or external provider subject is used or permitted.
